Supermarine Stranraer.fact: The project was pursued as a response to the Air Ministry's issuing of Specification R.24/31 in 1931, which called for a general purpose coastal reconnaissance flying boat for the RAF. The Air Ministry favoured Saunders-Roe's proposal and rejected Supermarine's design.

Supermarine Stranraer.question: This specification demanded a payload 1,000 pounds (_____) greater than that of the Scapa and the ability to maintain level flight on only a single engine, which the Scapa could not do
Supermarine Stranraer.fact: This specification demanded a payload 1,000 pounds (450 kg) greater than that of the Scapa and the ability to maintain level flight on only a single engine, which the Scapa could not do.

Supermarine Stranraer.question: On 24 _____ 1934 it was delivered to the Marine Aircraft Experimental Establishment (MAEE) at RAF Felixstowe for official trials
Supermarine Stranraer.fact: On 24 October 1934 it was delivered to the Marine Aircraft Experimental Establishment (MAEE) at RAF Felixstowe for official trials.

Supermarine Stranraer.question: The first production standard aircraft made its first flight in _____ 1936, and entered service operation with the RAF on 16 April 1937
Supermarine Stranraer.fact: The first production standard aircraft made its first flight in December 1936, and entered service operation with the RAF on 16 April 1937.

Supermarine Stranraer.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Supermarine Stranraer.question: The final Stranraer was delivered on 3 _____ 1939
Supermarine Stranraer.fact: The first production standard aircraft made its first flight in December 1936, and entered service operation with the RAF on 16 April 1937. The final Stranraer was delivered on 3 April 1939.

Supermarine Stranraer.question: The aircraft could carry up to 1,000 pounds (_____) of bombs

Supermarine Stranraer.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Supermarine Stranraer.question: As early as 1938, some Stranraer squadrons had begun to re-equip themselves with other aircraft, such as the _____ and Short Singapore flying boats
Supermarine Stranraer.fact: As early as 1938, some Stranraer squadrons had begun to re-equip themselves with other aircraft, such as the Short Sunderland and Short Singapore flying boats.

Supermarine Stranraer.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Supermarine Stranraer.question: After the end of the war, several examples served with _____ (QCA) in British Columbia, operating until 1958
Supermarine Stranraer.fact: After the end of the war, several examples served with Queen Charlotte Airlines (QCA) in British Columbia, operating until 1958. Queen Charlotte Airlines became at one point the third-largest airline in Canada; it was popularly called the Queer Collection of Aircraft.

Supermarine Stranraer.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Supermarine Stranraer.question: In 1970, it was bought by the RAF _____ and transported to the UK
Supermarine Stranraer.fact: In 1970, it was bought by the RAF Museum and transported to the UK. Parts of a second Stranraer, 915/CF-BYJ, are owned by the Shearwater Aviation Museum, Halifax, Canada.
